page.text:
The rational numbers extend the integers by allowing division by a
nonzero integer. Abstractly they form an ordered field. Concretely, a
pair $(a,b)$ with $b \ne 0$ represents the fraction $a/b$, and two pairs
represent the same rational exactly when their cross-products agree.
